svg.title: Hawkeye single-bit vector artwork reference
svg.desc: Black shows the actual 3.5 mm vector pocket regions. This is a simplified line-art interpretation, not a raster conversion of the photographic mockup. The analytic 100 mm disc and 4 mm hanger hole are separate retained-part geometry.
svg.text: 100 mm nominal part • artwork channels are 3.5 mm target width
